# Case Study
Business Analytics HT26 - Umeå University

Group 17:

## Introduction

For this analysis, we will use the `economics` dataset from `ggplot2`
https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/economics.html
and `unrate` from the US Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=UNRATE

OPTIONAL: Install packages if needed
```{r, packages}

install.packages("dplyr")
```

Load libraries and 
```{r, libraries}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
```

download unemployment rate
```{r, unemployment}
fedunrate <- read_csv("https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=UNRATE")

fedunrate <- fedunrate |>
  rename(date = observation_date) |>
  filter(date >= as.Date("1967-07-01"),
         date <= as.Date("2015-04-01"))

economicsWithUnrate <- economics |>
  left_join(fedunrate, by = "date")
```

## Overview

```{r, }
glimpse(economics)
View(economicsWithUnrate)
```

## Plots for 5. Descriptive analytics

```{r, }
ggplot(data = economicsWithUnrate, mapping = aes(x = date, y = "Unemployment rate and savings rate")) + geom_path(aes(y = UNRATE), color = "red") + geom_path(aes(y = psavert), color = "blue") 
```
